title: How clumsy you are, Miss Ueno.
synopsis:
The story centers on Ueno, a genius inventor who is in the third grade at her junior high school. She also serves as the head of the school's science club and secretly falls in love with one of its members, second grade student Tanaka. Using her eccentric inventions, Ueno tries to confess her love to him indirectly. But her attempts always end in failure.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: ROCKER-KUN / KUMATANDER NO. 2
episodes.synopsis: Tanaka is very oblivious when it comes to love. That said, Ueno methods can safely be described as extremely unconventional.

episodes.title: DASH-TAN / 1-7-6 PROTECTIVE GEAR
episodes.synopsis: Testing Ueno’s latest invention requires smelly clothes. Later, her new protective gear is foolproof! But maybe only in theory…

episodes.title: THE KILT HIDE / GARAKUTAN
episodes.synopsis: Kitanaga asks Ueno for something to censor prying eyes. Later, Ueno offers Tanaka some more water. He has suspicions this time...

episodes.title: UENO NO. 13 / The SummonStat
episodes.synopsis: Can Tanaka tell the difference between Ueno and a robot? Later, Ueno uses her scientific prowess to create life!

episodes.title: THE P-SPECTER / THE PE RESERVER
episodes.synopsis: Ueno investigates mysterious rumors as a ploy to bond with Tanaka. Later, a revolutionary water filtration system involves super absorbent gym clothes.

episodes.title: II UMBRELLA / E-Q BOOSTER
episodes.synopsis: Why suffer the inconvenience of using umbrellas when superior anti-gravitational fields can do the job better? Later, a belt promises to give Ueno an edge in a sumo match.

episodes.title: PANTY ROTI / THE GATCHA-PORTER
episodes.synopsis: Is Tanaka so hungry he’d be willing to eat anything? Afterwards, this toy capsule vending machine dispenses unconventional items.

episodes.title: COITSU NATE LUNA D/Pero-Lilion
episodes.synopsis: Will the truth finally come out thanks to a sleeping pill? Later, Tanaka’s sisters stop by for a visit!

episodes.title: JIGATIGHTS / SQ-WATER
episodes.synopsis: Can Ueno use tights to charge a cell phone? She seems to have found a way! She also has an idea regarding a new use for swimsuits.

episodes.title: KANCHIKAN / REPARA-TE
episodes.synopsis: A cute accessory is actually an alarm system in disguise. Sometime later, Ueno’s next creation unexpectedly leads to inquiries regarding leg hair.

episodes.title: INVISI-BLOOMER / THE REAR-SKIRT
episodes.synopsis: Chairs are now obsolete forever! That is if Ueno would only consider the practical applications of her invention. Later on, the Tennis Club needs Ueno’s help.

episodes.title: GAN-Q / BALLET-TAN
episodes.synopsis: Tanaka, you really need to stop and think about what comes out of your mouth. Later, Ueno creates a device that shares sensory experiences? ...It’s gonna backfire, isn’t it?
